title: My AI doesn't pick trades. It stops me from being an idiot. (open source, free)
author: mphinance
selftext:
Mostly created to fix my position sizing in futures, but I also wanted to see the 15m, 1h, and tick charts all sitting next to my 5m at all times. 

https://github.com/tradernetwork/projectx-desk

https://mphinance.substack.com/p/phd-in-self-sabotage-my-ai-trading?utm\_source=share&utm\_medium=android&r=1sctub

\- Three losses in a row = locked out

\- Sizes from remaining loss room + ATR stop, always rounds down. If 1 contract risks too much, it says REFUSED and tells you why

\- Stop goes out right after the fill. No ack in 5 sec = flatten and halt

\- Stops only move toward price. No widening because "hope"

\- AI can STAGE a trade. Only I can PLACE it (hold 600 ms)

\- Shows my win rate next to the win rate I need to break even. Flags SMALL SAMPLE under 30 trades
